unit: One tracked language conformance area. Related JLS requirements belong to one area when they share an implementation and verification boundary.

statusRules.verified: The stated scope has executable coverage backed by a differential or an equivalent conformance check.
statusRules.partial: Executable coverage exists for part of the stated scope. The remaining rule or profile is recorded in open.
statusRules.missing: The target executable behavior has no demonstrated implementation. Analysis-only support is identified separately when present.

countingRule: Count every stable or preview row whose status is partial or missing. Keep IDs stable, record the implementation commit and evidence at closure, and report changes to the checklist denominator separately.
scope: Java source analysis, executable Java-to-GPP AOT lowering, and corresponding native GPP language semantics. The platform libraries, dynamic JVM integration, tools, performance, and Spring module ports have separate completion criteria.

stable.scope: Unicode escapes, lexical translations, identifiers and keywords
stable.evidence: JavaSourceAnalysis.java uses javac source attribution.
stable.open: Verify lexical and source-position behavior across import and native source modes.

stable.scope: Literal syntax and values, including text blocks, escapes and null
stable.evidence: primitive_casts_differential_test.go and object string tests cover attributed literals.
stable.open: Exercise all Java literal forms in executable lowering and source-mode diagnostics.

stable.scope: Fixed-width primitive values, promotions, arithmetic, comparison and logical operators
stable.evidence: Primitive differentials cover arithmetic, bitwise and short-circuit operators. Update differentials verify Java narrowing and updates to boxed values, arrays, and qualified instance and static fields.
stable.open: Complete native Java-width operator behavior and remaining generic and volatile operand cases.

stable.scope: Widening and narrowing in casts, assignments, calls and numeric contexts
stable.evidence: primitive_casts_differential_test.go verifies explicit AOT casts and boundary values.
stable.open: Cover implicit and constant conversions across all assignment and invocation contexts.

stable.scope: Boxing, unboxing, wrapper identity and null
stable.evidence: Boxing, conditionals and compound-update differentials cover all wrappers, cached identity, unboxing in operators and reboxing of updates.
stable.open: Complete conversions in generic calls, remaining override and invocation contexts, and native Java-compatible source.

stable.scope: UTF-16 strings, interning, string conversion and concatenation
stable.evidence: String and update differentials cover literals, UTF-16 and String +=. Primitive differentials check Float and Double formatting. string_concat_differential_test.go verifies binary concatenation, constant interning, operand order, virtual toString, and identity-hash text for objects and covariant arrays.
stable.open: Finish Java-compatible native source operators and string conversion for platform and dynamic object types.

stable.scope: Reference identity, null, checked casts and type tests
stable.evidence: Reference-cast, array and interface differentials exercise identity, embedded base views, nominal casts and Go callbacks across facades. Additional tests cover typed pattern views, stable default hashes and non-generic interface intersections.
stable.open: Complete generic and remaining interface adaptation, Java array supertypes and identity in the dynamic profile.

stable.scope: Array allocation, access, identity, covariance and store checks
stable.evidence: Arrays, compound updates and interface differentials cover allocation and dimensions, identity, rank and covariance checks, checked stores, boxed updates and nominal interface-array casts.
stable.open: Add cloning, Cloneable and Serializable supertypes, and arrays in generic, variable-arity and utility-emitter signatures.

stable.scope: Java name resolution, shadowing, scope and binary names
stable.evidence: Java analyzer records attributed symbols. Native package and static-field resolution have regression tests.
stable.open: Exercise Java naming and scoping in all supported declarations and bindings.

stable.scope: Java public, protected, package and private access rules
stable.evidence: static_field_visibility_test.go exercises native visibility and javac checks source access. object_fields_test.go verifies private peer access, cross-package protected access and typed Go accessors, including read-only final fields.
stable.open: Cover nested access, interface, module, and all remaining protected receiver rules across execution profiles.

stable.scope: Packages, ordinary imports and static imports
stable.evidence: emit_packages.go handles attributed logical packages and cycles.
stable.open: Complete wildcard and static import coverage and all package-level declaration forms.

stable.scope: Single-module import declarations
stable.evidence: Java source analysis delegates release-specific parsing to javac.
stable.open: Verify executable dependency resolution, module readability, ambiguity and native equivalents.

stable.scope: JPMS declarations, directives and module access semantics
stable.evidence: analyze_test.go verifies module directive reporting.
stable.open: Emit and enforce modules, readability, qualified exports and opens, and service use and provision.

stable.scope: Compilation units, compact source files and Java entry-point selection
stable.evidence: The CLI analyzes Java units and runs native GPP executables.
stable.open: Execute ordinary and compact Java programs with the Java 27 main-method selection rules.

stable.scope: Field declarations, selection, hiding, storage and qualified receivers
stable.evidence: Native visibility tests exercise static fields. OpenJDK differentials verify qualified instance and static field reads and updates, field hiding, declaring-class selection, constant access and evaluation order.
stable.open: Complete volatile fields and the native, nested-type and interface field models.

stable.scope: Instance initialization order, defaults and dispatch during construction
stable.evidence: Native and AOT differentials check construction order, dispatch and Java record component initialization under canonical and compact constructors.
stable.open: Close remaining declaration-form, abrupt-exit and cross-profile initialization cases.

stable.scope: Static initialization, active use, concurrency and erroneous classes
stable.evidence: Native tests cover lazy use, reflection and failures. static_initialization_differential_test.go verifies class active use, superclass and declaration order, recursive use, and failed initialization against OpenJDK, with concurrent Go callers.
stable.open: Implement interface initialization, class-loader policies, and the OpenJDK diagnostic cause of a cached initialization failure.

stable.scope: Java constant expressions, constant variables, folding and passive access
stable.evidence: class_constants.go and field tests cover supported constants and passive access, including evaluating expression qualifiers. javac-attributed binary String constants preserve Java folding and interning through AOT.
stable.open: Cover remaining constant operators, dependencies, numeric narrowing, IEEE special values and cross-profile folding.

stable.scope: Definite assignment and unassignment for locals and blank final fields
stable.evidence: static_final_flow.go and native blank-static-final differential tests cover selected structured paths.
stable.open: Implement the full Java flow rules for local and instance finals, including exception and pattern paths.

stable.scope: Constructor selection, delegation, initialization and superclass calls
stable.evidence: object_classes.go and native constructor tests cover selected this and super chains.
stable.open: Complete overload phases, visibility, anonymous and inner creation, and general Java parameter conversion.

stable.scope: Flexible constructor bodies and early construction context
stable.evidence: Native constructor prologue and delegation tests cover selected early statements.
stable.open: Lower attributed Java pre-super statements and enforce the complete early construction restrictions.

stable.scope: Class inheritance, modifiers, overrides, abstract members and dispatch
stable.evidence: Native and AOT differentials exercise base and derived calls, including abstract methods in a sealed hierarchy and native owner binding with and without explicit initializers.
stable.open: Complete and verify Java abstract, bridge, covariant return, visibility and final interactions across profiles.

stable.scope: Method overload resolution, invocation phases, conversion and variable arity
stable.evidence: Native overload resolution and attributed calls cover a subset of Java invocation.
stable.open: Complete boxing and variable-arity overload phases, most-specific selection and emitted overload bodies.

stable.scope: Member and inner types, enclosing instances and qualified this and super
stable.evidence: The analyzer records nested declarations.
stable.open: Represent enclosing instances and emit executable nested and inner class semantics.

stable.scope: Local and anonymous classes and interfaces
stable.evidence: Java attribution can identify their symbols.
stable.open: Implement local declarations, capture, construction and dynamic identity.

stable.scope: Interface contracts, default, static and private methods, inheritance and override resolution
stable.evidence: interfaces_differential_test.go verifies public non-generic interfaces, inherited default selection, qualified super calls, diamond and class precedence, nominal identity, and an external Go implementation.
stable.open: Implement static and private interface methods, covariant and overloaded signatures, generic and abstract-class adaptation, and full interface initialization.

stable.scope: Enum classes, constant bodies, identity, construction and implicit members
stable.evidence: Native GPP has enums and AOT analyzer recognizes Java enum declarations.
stable.open: Provide Java enum class semantics, switch behavior and executable import.

stable.scope: Records, components, canonical and compact constructors and implicit methods
stable.evidence: records_differential_test.go covers non-generic records, constructors, accessors and generated Object methods. Record-switch tests verify deconstruction through accessors and accessor exception wrapping.
stable.open: Complete generic, variable-arity, local and nested records, reflection and annotation propagation, serialization, and native record declarations.

stable.scope: Sealed, non-sealed and permitted subclasses and interfaces
stable.evidence: sealed_differential_test.go verifies explicit and inferred AOT permits, sealed classes and interfaces, abstract base dispatch, permitted record and open branches, exhaustive switch, and native final, sealed and non-sealed classes.
stable.open: Complete nominal sealed interfaces in native GPP, named-module and separate-linkage behavior, nested permitted types and remaining compiler and dynamic profile checks.

stable.scope: Generic types, erasure, wildcards, raw types, bounds and capture
stable.evidence: GPP has Go generics. The analyzer records Java type parameters and bounds.
stable.open: Implement Java erased representation and wildcard, raw and capture semantics in executable code.

stable.scope: Java invocation and diamond inference, poly expressions and constraints
stable.evidence: javac reports inferred types for analyzed Java source.
stable.open: Preserve attributed inference through executable generic calls and implement native Java-compatible inference.

stable.scope: Annotation declarations, targets, defaults, values and type-use applications
stable.evidence: compiler/annotations.go and analyzer annotation metadata tests cover subsets.
stable.open: Execute imported annotation applications and cover nested values, legal targets and type-use metadata.

stable.scope: Retention and repeatable annotation containers
stable.evidence: GPP preserves repeated native uses. javac reports Java annotation metadata.
stable.open: Implement explicit containers, Java retention semantics and container presence in reflection.

stable.scope: Native opt-in by-type class annotation lookup along the primary superclass chain
stable.evidence: native_inheritable_class_annotations_test.go compares closest declarations, repeat order, type identity and passive lookup with OpenJDK.

stable.scope: Local variables, var inference, unnamed variables and effectively final capture
stable.evidence: object_emission.go supports selected attributed local variables.
stable.open: Cover all local declaration forms and capture, including unnamed bindings and inferred generic types.

stable.scope: Assignment expressions and compound assignments
stable.evidence: OpenJDK differentials verify saved values, narrowing, boxed updates and typed assignments to arrays and qualified instance and static fields.
stable.open: Complete remaining variable and operator combinations and general object string conversion.

stable.scope: Conditional statements and conditional-expression typing
stable.evidence: conditional_expressions_test.go verifies AOT type attribution, numeric conversion, selected branch execution, boxed or null results and null-result side effects. Native GPP has ternary expressions.
stable.open: Complete target typing with general interfaces and generics and verify equivalent native semantics.

stable.scope: while, do-while, basic and enhanced for loops
stable.evidence: object_loops_test.go compares while, do-while, classic for and enhanced for over arrays, with labeled transfers, cleanup and ordered updates.
stable.open: Implement Iterable enhanced for and complete native semantics for Java loop forms and update expressions.

stable.scope: Labeled statements, break and continue targets
stable.evidence: native_labeled_blocks_test.go and object_loops_test.go cover native labeled block exits and imported labeled blocks and loops, including transfers through finally.
stable.open: Cover non-block, non-loop targets in native code and full switch branch targets in imported code.

stable.scope: Switch statements and expressions, fallthrough, exhaustiveness and yield
stable.evidence: Differentials cover classic groups, fallthrough, arrow rules, yield, null cases, primitive and String selectors, guarded reference labels, record deconstruction, and an exhaustive sealed switch.
stable.open: Implement Java enum selectors, remaining constant label expressions, cases with shared custom record accessors, and switch lowering in the static utility emitter.

stable.scope: Binding and record patterns and their flow scopes
stable.evidence: Pattern differentials verify reference instanceof flow scopes, guarded switch labels, nested record deconstruction in switch and instanceof, nominal and array views, and Java MatchException behavior.
stable.open: Implement generic and additional record types, shared custom accessor evaluation across record arms and Java-compatible native pattern syntax.

stable.scope: Throw, catch, multi-catch, checked exceptions and exception analysis
stable.evidence: Object, arithmetic, array and assertion differentials exercise typed catches and cleanup. AssertionError belongs to the Java Error and Throwable hierarchy.
stable.open: Complete checked exception analysis and general throwable hierarchies across profiles.

stable.scope: Native finally completion precedence for return, throw and branches to supported structured targets
stable.evidence: native_finally_completion_test.go compares nested and overriding control transfers with OpenJDK.

stable.scope: Executable finally semantics in imported Java code
stable.evidence: object_exceptions_test.go, object_loops_test.go and object_switch_test.go exercise normal and abrupt completion, including return, throw, break, continue and yield, nested cleanup and replacement of a pending Java completion.

stable.scope: Try-with-resources, closing order, suppression and exceptional exits
stable.evidence: Java AOT resource tests exercise suppression and runtime AutoCloseable.
stable.open: Cover all resource forms, general AutoCloseable implementations and equivalent native language constructs.

stable.scope: Java assert statements and enablement semantics
stable.evidence: assertions_differential_test.go compares OpenJDK default and -ea runs, skipping conditions and details, AssertionError identity, frozen settings, and javac definite assignment. Interface tests cover assertion status in default methods.
stable.open: Complete Java class-loader and package policies, nested types and circular initialization cases, arbitrary object details and native language support.

stable.scope: SAM target typing, lambda capture, conversion and object adaptation
stable.evidence: lambda_differential_test.go verifies translated non-generic SAMs, capture snapshots, lexical this, expression and block bodies, boxing, defaults, interface intersections, and interoperability with an external Go implementation.
stable.open: Support generic and external JDK SAMs, covariant function signatures, class-containing intersections and equivalent native Java lambda rules.

stable.scope: Bound and unbound method references and constructor references
stable.evidence: lambda_differential_test.go verifies static, bound and unbound references, this, superclass and interface-super references, class and array constructors, conversion and void adaptation, and bound null timing.
stable.open: Complete generic and external JDK targets, expanded varargs, remaining reference forms and Java-compatible native method-reference rules.

stable.scope: Left-to-right evaluation, side effects and exception timing
stable.evidence: Differentials cover ordered binary, array, pattern and selector evaluation, lazy assertions and qualified receiver timing. They verify static active-use timing, string conversion before the next operand, bound method-reference null checks, and record component extraction and failure order.
stable.open: Audit remaining reference and allocation forms, shared custom record accessors and Java-compatible native evaluation.

stable.scope: Java monitors, wait sets, synchronized methods, volatile, final fields and happens-before
stable.evidence: Native GPP uses Go synchronization and has a class initialization protocol.
stable.open: Implement and validate the Java synchronization and memory-model guarantees.

stable.scope: Java loading, linking, class identity and binary compatibility
stable.evidence: The JVM interop probe exercises extension subclasses through two class loaders.
stable.open: Verify loading and linkage rules across actual dynamic integration, and define native compatibility for supported linkage and class lifecycle.

preview.scope: Versioned preview opt-in, checking and execution restrictions
preview.evidence: analyze_test.go toggles preview analysis against the selected JDK release.
preview.open: Enforce per-release compatibility across source, emitted artifacts and runtime execution.

preview.scope: Java SE 27 preview of primitive patterns, instanceof and switch
preview.evidence: The analyzer can attribute a gated primitive instanceof pattern.
preview.open: Implement executable semantics and differential tests with preview enabled and disabled.
